name: Three-phase star autotransformer
summary: A three-phase star-connected autotransformer has electrically shared winding portions arranged in a three-phase star connection.
description: A three-phase star-connected autotransformer has electrically shared winding portions arranged in a three-phase star connection. Its neutral and tap connections need explicit identification.
readingNotes: Determine how the common star point and any accessible neutral are used by the design.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A star autotransformer is electrically different from a star-star two-winding transformer.
